card.fact_statement: Takeshi Iwaya endorsed Yoshimasa Hayashi in the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election.
card.source_span: Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya, who led Shigeru Ishiba's campaign the previous year, said he would vote for Hayashi.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni Waziri gani wa Mambo ya Nje aliyemuunga mkono Yoshimasa Hayashi katika uchaguzi wa rais wa Chama cha Kiliberali cha Kidemokrasia wa mwaka 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya, who led Shigeru Ishiba's campaign the previous year, said he would vote for Hayashi.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Foreign Minister' to 'Waziri wa Mambo ya Nje' and 'Liberal Democratic Party' to 'Chama cha Kiliberali cha Kidemokrasia'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which Minister of Foreign Affairs supported Yoshimasa Hayashi in the 2025 presidential election of the Liberal Democratic Party?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target-language QA accurately preserves the entity, relation, and expected answer of the source QA without introducing new constraints.
